DJ HighRize – Professional DJ & Master of Vibes

Meet Larry, better known behind the decks as DJ HighRize—a seasoned entertainer with over a decade of experience in creating unforgettable moments on the dance floor. Originally from Fort Wayne, Indiana, Larry’s musical journey took root in Tampa and Orlando, Florida, where he discovered his true passion: moving people through music and crafting lasting memories at every event.

Since 2008, DJ HighRize has been the life of the party at weddings, corporate events, birthday celebrations, and upscale lounge gatherings. No matter the setting, Larry brings professionalism, charisma, and high energy that keeps guests engaged from the first song to the final encore.

With a music catalog that spans all genres, DJ HighRize effortlessly curates a soundtrack tailored to each crowd. His go-to floor fillers like “Cupid Shuffle,” “The Wobble,” “This Is How We Do It,” and “Return of the Mack” are guaranteed to get everyone on their feet.

Larry is not just a DJ—he’s a vibe curator, crowd motivator, and memory maker.

When he’s not rocking events, you’ll find him playing basketball, working out, or enjoying movie nights with his wife and their beloved fur baby.

If you’re looking for a DJ who knows how to bring the energy, keep the dance floor alive, and create a seamless, fun experience from start to finish—DJ HighRize is your guy.
